Split model terms into their covariate and level

dot-split_terms.Rd

fixest names a category's coefficient by pasting the column name and the level (genderM), and a numeric covariate's by its name alone (age). Used by tidy.survival_model() to give each term its covariate and level.

Usage

.split_terms(terms, covariate_cols)

Arguments

terms

Character vector of coefficient names.

covariate_cols

Character vector of the model's covariates.

Value

A list of two character vectors as long as terms: covariate (the longest covariate name the term starts with, so grade_bandB is grade_band, not grade) and level (the rest; NA for a numeric covariate).
